Name: Multi Yield Crops
Author: CherryChain
Description:
This mod lets you add one or more extra yields for any crops you want (including custom crops).


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
This mod doesn't do anything by default. You can just install the mod, and it'll work automatically for content packs which use it.

You can add harvest rules by editing the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file (which is generated when you run the game with the mod) or creating a content pack. See the [url=https://github.com/ChroniclerCherry/stardew-valley-mods/blob/develop/MultiYieldCrops/docs/README.md]technical documentation[/url] for help doing either of those.


[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, this mod doesn't make any changes to your save file. If you remove the mod, the crops just won't produce extra yields anymore.[/quote]
